entries.TIMELINE_ALLEY_1: [shake rate=30 level=10]Birb![/shake][w=0.4] Where are you?![w=0.4] Don't scare me like this...[w=0.6] please make a sound!
entries.TIMELINE_ALLEY_2: I was so [shake rate=25 level=8]terrified[/shake] back then...[w=0.6] But you searched down this dark alley just to find me.
entries.TIMELINE_ALLEY_3: Even now...[w=0.7] you must be [shake rate=22 level=7]frantically[/shake] looking for me.....[w=0.8] right?
entries.TIMELINE_BUS_STOP_1: Another exhausting day...[w=0.6] I just want to rush back home and see my bird.
entries.TIMELINE_BUS_STOP_2: You always looked so worn out at this bus stop...[w=0.6] That's why I always waited near the door to make you smile.
entries.TIMELINE_BUS_STOP_3: I..[w=0.5] I need to hurry home...[w=0.6] You must be [shake rate=18 level=5]tired[/shake] and waiting for me.
entries.TIMELINE_CAFE_1: We used to come here every afternoon.[w=0.5] You enjoyed your coffee,[w=0.3] while I begged for your breadcrumbs.
entries.TIMELINE_CAFE_2: Your chirping always makes this cafe feel so peaceful,[w=0.4] Birb.
entries.TIMELINE_CAFE_3: Laughing together at this table...[w=0.7] still feels so warm in my memory.
entries.TIMELINE_HOUSE_2: It turns out...[w=0.9] that warm smile of yours doesn't belong to me [shake rate=12 level=3]anymore[/shake].
entries.TIMELINE_PARK_1: Whenever the outside world gets exhausting,[w=0.4] just sitting in the park with you is enough to calm me down.
entries.TIMELINE_PARK_2: I always felt safe just standing by your side,[w=0.3] too.
entries.TIMELINE_PARK_3: That warmth...[w=0.8] is slowly bringing color back around me.
entries.TIMELINE_PET_SHOP_1: This is where we first met.[w=0.6] Your smile back then...[w=0.7] was so warm.
entries.TIMELINE_PET_SHOP_2: Finally, I have a little companion in this city.[w=0.5] From today on, your name is [shake rate=15 level=4]Birb[/shake]!
entries.TIMELINE_PET_SHOP_2_1: This is where we first met.[w=0.6] Your smile back then...[w=0.7] was so warm.
entries.TIMELINE_PET_SHOP_2_2: Finally, I have a little companion in this city.[w=0.5] From today on, your name is [shake rate=15 level=4]Birb[/shake]!
entries.TIMELINE_PET_SHOP_2_3: Remembering this moment makes this gloomy street feel a bit more colorful...
entries.TIMELINE_PET_SHOP_3: Remembering this moment makes this gloomy street feel a bit more colorful...
entries.TIMELINE_START_SPAWN_1: Why is my body lying so still over there...[w=0.7] It's so [shake rate=20 level=6]cold[/shake]...
entries.TIMELINE_START_SPAWN_2: Why am I on this street?[w=0.6] Someone...[w=0.5] feels like someone is waiting for me back home...
entries.TIMELINE_START_SPAWN_3: I'm...[w=0.6] slowly [shake rate=25 level=8]forgetting your face[/shake]..
